about:
# Caerdon Wardrobe

Let Caerdon Wardrobe help you get your transmog closet overflowing with style ... *you fabulous thing, you*!

It puts a small icon on the items worth a second look: appearances, recipes, pets, mounts and toys you haven't learned, gear upgrades, quest items, things worth auctioning, and what's safe to sell. One glance at your bags tells you what to learn, what to mail to an alt and what to vendor.

Works on **World of Warcraft (Retail)** and **World of Warcraft: Forever**, from the same download.

## Support Caerdon Wardrobe

[![Buy Me a Coffee](https://cdn.buymeacoffee.com/buttons/v2/default-yellow.png)](https://buymeacoffee.com/caerdon)

If Caerdon Wardrobe has been useful to you and you'd like to buy me a drink, **[buymeacoffee.com/caerdon](https://buymeacoffee.com/caerdon)** is the place. Thank you!

## What the icons mean

| Icon | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Star** | An appearance, recipe, pet, mount or toy this toon can learn. A green star is a look you already have from another item, or an ensemble with only a few pieces for this toon. Also a bag that belongs in one of your bag slots. |
| **Question mark** | This toon can't use it, but it can still be learned for your collection or by another toon. Green means one of your toons already has it. |
| **Arrow** | Gear better than what you have equipped. Yellow when Pawn says so, green for a higher item level, red when it is for another spec. The item level gain (such as +5) can be shown next to it. |
| **Quest marker** | A quest item, or anything a quest will ask you to hand in. |
| **Auction** | Sells for enough more on the auction house than at a vendor to be worth the trip. Needs Auctionator. |
| **Bag** | Nothing left for this toon to do with it: sell it. Includes food and drink you have outgrown and bags no bigger than the ones you have equipped. |
| **WoW logo** | Left over from an older expansion, to help clear out the bags. |
| **Text** | How the item binds (BoE, BoA) or the gear set it belongs to. |

Items in your bags are also marked when they can be opened, are locked, can be read, can be combined or can still be refunded.

Every icon has its own block in the settings that explains it and lets you choose where it shows.

## Where they show

Bags and bank, guild bank, vendors, the auction house, the Black Market, crafting orders, the loot window, loot rolls, quest rewards, mail, professions, the dressing room, the dungeon journal, the world map, mission rewards, the Great Vault and item conversion. Windows that only exist on Retail are simply absent on WoW Forever.

Tooltips can also say which of your toons can learn a recipe.

## Works with other addons

- **Bag and UI addons:** AdiBags, ArkInventory, Baganator, Bagnon, Bagnonium, BaudBag, BetterBags, cargBags_Nivaya, ElvUI, GudaBags, Inventorian, KkthnxUI, LiteBag, NDui and Sorted.
- **Other windows:** Auctionator, Dialogue UI, Narcissus, Skillet, Venture Plan, Angrier World Quests, World Quests List, World Quest Tab, World Quest Tracker and Zygor.
- **Better answers when installed:** Pawn (upgrades), Auctionator (auction prices) and QuestieDB (items for quests you have not picked up yet).

## Settings

Type `/caerdon`, or open the game's settings and pick **Caerdon Wardrobe** under AddOns.

- **Icons:** what each icon means, where it shows, and the rules behind it.
- **Display:** how the icons and text are drawn, plus the vendor, tooltip and debug options. The layout editor (`/caerdonlayout`) lets you move and resize the icon and the texts on a live example.

## Getting it

Download it from **[CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/caerdon-wardrobe)**, or search for **Caerdon Wardrobe** in your addon manager, on Wago or on WoWInterface.

## Something looks wrong?

Please [open an issue](https://github.com/Caerdon/CaerdonWardrobe/issues). It helps a lot to include the item's details: type `/cdebug` to open the debug frame, point it at the item, press **Copy Details** and paste the result into the issue.

I don't like slow addons and try my best to keep this one from impacting your fun. If Caerdon Wardrobe is slowing your game down, please let me know!

# What's new in Caerdon Wardrobe v6.2.0

Caerdon Wardrobe now works with GudaBags.

## GudaBags

- **Icons in GudaBags' bags and bank:** the status icon, the binding text and the item level gain on every slot, placed by your layout at any slot size you set in GudaBags.
- **One mark for one thing.** Where Caerdon Wardrobe shows its own upgrade arrow, quest icon, binding text or gear set on a slot, GudaBags' mark for the same is hidden there: its upgrade arrow (Pawn's), its quest marks, its BoE and BoA labels and its equipment set mark. Switch one of those off in Caerdon Wardrobe's settings and GudaBags' own shows again. The layout editor (`/caerdonlayout`) has a note that says so while GudaBags is loaded.
- GudaBags' other marks stay as they are: its junk coin, item level, borders, charges, lock and the rest.
- Its guild bank and its view of another character's bags have no Caerdon Wardrobe icons.

# What was new in v6.1.0

Daylight UI's windows on WoW Forever have their icons, and two fixes for both games.

## Daylight UI (WoW Forever)

- **Icons in Daylight UI's own windows:** the vendor, the auction house, the mailbox, a quest's items at the NPC and in the quest journal, loot roll cards, and the profession window's recipe list and picked recipe.
- **One upgrade arrow in a bag slot.** Where Caerdon Wardrobe shows its arrow, Pawn's is no longer drawn beside it.
- **Your layout in Daylight UI's bags and bank, if you want it.** Daylight UI puts the icon in a slot's top right corner at a size of its own. The layout editor (`/caerdonlayout`) has a box, "Use my layout in Daylight UI's bags and bank", that puts it where your layout does. Daylight UI has marks of its own in a slot's corners, which the icon can then lie across.
- **The upgrade line of a comparison tooltip is one of Daylight UI's "If you swap" chips.** On Daylight UI's own tooltip cards, what a piece would gain you over the one you are wearing ("+30% Main") stands with the stat changes, green for an upgrade and red for a loss. A line that says more than that (both hands, PvP gear, another spec, a later level) stays a line.
- A slot that empties no longer keeps the item level gain of the item that left it, and the bags' icons follow what you learn, equip or change in the settings without being filled again.
- The bank no longer opens without its icons when the bags were opened before it.

## Fixes

- **WoW Forever, auction house:** a listing with a random suffix ("of the Bear") is compared with its suffix's stats, so it can show as the upgrade it is.
- **Thrown weapons** are no longer marked as a look to collect for another toon. The wardrobe has no place for them.

# What was new in v6.0.1

Fixes for the loot window, and for the sell, auction and mail icons on a hunter's pet food on WoW Forever.

- **Loot window:** every row has its icon again. Since v6.0.0 a quest item showed none there, and a piece of gear got its star only after a pause.
- **WoW Forever, hunters:** more of the food your pet eats is marked as safe to sell or auction. With plenty of its best food in your bags, the other kinds it eats get the icon; a second kind is left unmarked only while the best one is down to its last few pieces.
- **WoW Forever, hunters:** food that another of your toons' recipes take keeps its mail icon in your bags, as it has in the bank. Only your pet's best food is left without it.

# What was new in v6.0.0

A big update for both World of Warcraft (Retail) and WoW Forever. The icons are right in more places, and there are several new things to see in your bags.

## Upgrades

- **The arrow knows your loadouts.** A piece is compared with what you are wearing, with each gear set you have saved and with your other specs. A yellow arrow is an upgrade for what you are wearing on your spec's Pawn scale, a green one is a higher item level alone, and a red one is an upgrade for gear you are not wearing or for another spec.
- **The tooltip says what an upgrade is for, and by how much.**
- **Set bonuses.** The tooltip tells you when wearing a piece would gain or lose a tier set bonus, so an arrow never quietly costs you one.
- **Weapons are compared by the hands they take:** a two-hander against both pieces it would replace, a one-hander together with the best partner in your bags.
- **Gear sets can have a Pawn scale of their own,** and a set can be marked as PvP gear so that it is compared at PvP item levels. A set you named after one of your specs (or talent trees on WoW Forever) is matched to it by its name.
- **An upgrade you cannot wear yet** shows the grey gear in place of the arrow, and its tooltip says at which level it becomes one.
- **WoW Forever has upgrades too.** There are no specs there, so the talent tree with the most points decides which Pawn scale is yours.
- Where Pawn and Caerdon Wardrobe would say different things in a tooltip, you see one answer. An option brings Pawn's own notes back.

Everything above is set in the Upgrade block of the Icons page.

## Gear worth keeping for its next look (Retail)

- A piece whose look you already have is no longer marked for sale when it would get a look you are missing by being upgraded on its track or converted at the Catalyst. It gets a small mark that says which of the two to do.

## Quests

- **The quest icon goes away when the quest is behind you.** A quest item you have no more use for is marked as safe to sell.
- **Items for quests you have not picked up yet** now work with AllTheThings as well as QuestieDB, which brings them to Retail. You choose how far ahead to look and whether gray quests count. Gray quests are left out unless you switch them on (Icons page, "Also quests that have turned gray for this character"): at the level cap that is most older quests, so their items show no quest icon until you do.
- **An item that starts a quest** you have not taken gets the star with a small quest mark: use it.
- **Something a quest needs is never marked as a look to learn.** The quest icon comes first, so you do not sell or mail away what you have to hand in.
- A quest item you can read keeps its quest icon, with a small mark for the reading.
- The quest icon shows on auction house listings, with its own switch.
- The quest icon's setting is now followed in Sorted's bags and in the world quest list addons.

## Your other toons

- **A new mail icon** marks what this toon has no use for and another of your toons does: a recipe it can learn, an ingredient its recipes take, or a spell book or rune for its class. The tooltip names the toon.
- The mail icon stays away when that toon already has a copy in its bags, bank or mailbox, and from ingredients that vendors sell everywhere. Once you have bought or picked up one for every toon that wants it, the icon leaves the other copies too.
- **Spell books and runes** that teach this toon a spell it does not know get the star, or the grey gear until it has the level.
- **Ingredients your recipes have outgrown** are marked as safe to sell. Open each profession window once so the addon can note your recipes.

## Safe to sell

- WoW Forever: gear with classic stats such as spell power or attack power is no longer held back from the sell icon once you have its look.
- A piece you cannot wear yet is no longer kept just because its item level matches what you have on.
- WoW Forever: a hunter's food is kept by what the pet actually eats.

## Other addons

- **Skillet:** its recipe list shows the icon of what each recipe makes, as the game's own profession window does.
- **World Quest Tab** (Retail) is supported again: reward icons in its list and on its map pins.
- **Angrier World Quests:** the item level gain is no longer drawn over the reward's icon.

## Fixes

- Icons in BaudBag and Inventorian update after you learn a look or swap gear.
- BetterBags: every button is drawn when two of them show the same item.
- The combine icon is there after logging in, not only after a reload.
- A crafted piece you can still recraft is no longer marked for sale now and then.
- Housing: an item that teaches something you already know no longer gets a star.
- Changing spec or loot spec updates the icons.
- A recipe item is matched to its recipe where the two are worded differently.
- An ensemble's tooltip no longer has an empty row where the "Already known" line was hidden.
- WoW Forever: what the addon remembers about your toons is kept again now that the client no longer gives a realm name.
- A problem with one item or one supported addon no longer stops the icons everywhere else.

## Tidied up

- The tooltip switches sit with the icon they belong to on the Icons page.
- A change in the settings applies as soon as you click it.

Something looks wrong? Type `/cdebug`, point the debug frame at the item, press **Copy Details** and paste the result into an issue at https://github.com/Caerdon/CaerdonWardrobe/issues. Thank you!
